findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Test
Case: normal use - a source pull request changes a generator or template and runs its checks in CI.
The replacement test forces `test_place = "local"` and changes only `src/forge/prcheck.py`. Forge's own configuration instead runs tests in CI (`forge.toml:8` and `src/forge/repo.py:604-607`). The test would still pass if the CI `forge test --change` path skipped the release sync check, or if `src/forge/fasttest.py:797` stopped selecting it for template changes. The previous finding therefore remains open for those paths.

why: A change to the workflow generator (prcheck.py or the templates) can merge without the regenerated .github/workflows/forge.yml, which turns main red (it happened on 18 Nov 2026), and after a release bump merges, a branch that merges main pins a release that is not published yet, so close fails with 'Failed to resolve --with requirement' until the release is out
